timing_scope.preparation: Complete node HistoryStep preparation; excludes wallet authorization, PoW and delivery.
timing_scope.verification: Each distinct received terminal, normal sequential daemon cache; before native application.
timing_scope.application: Logged exact-suffix commit after terminal verification, including State and wallet work.
timing_scope.admission: Serialized producer wallet submissions until both mempools hold every intent. Receiver CPU delta includes its background work during that interval; wall time is not a saturated relay-throughput measurement.
timing_scope.resources: Constrained receiving daemon, including startup, admission, block verification, State, wallet and receipts; not prover memory.
